prompts.style: Stylized 3D cartoon render with soft matte clay-like materials, rounded chunky simplified shapes, a miniature diorama feel, soft global illumination and gentle ambient occlusion shadows, a clean uncluttered composition, crisp edges. No text, no letters, no numbers, no lettering on any sign, no logos, no brand marks, no watermark. Any person is small, seen from behind or in silhouette, with no detailed face.
prompts.google-ads/hero: A fly fisherman standing on a grassy riverbank mid-cast, seen from behind, the fly line unrolling in a long graceful loop over a calm winding river, a tiny fly at the end of the line just above the water. Colors: the river and the angler's vest in bright blue (#4285F4), the cap and the fly in red (#EA4335), small wildflowers and warm sunlight in yellow (#FBBC04), the grass and trees in green (#34A853), the whole scene set on a clean bright white background (#FFFFFF) with very light grey (#F8F9FA) shadows. + style
prompts.website-build/hero: A small, elegant shopfront on a quiet street corner at dusk: tall display windows glowing with warm golden light from inside, the front door standing open with light spilling onto the sidewalk, a blank hanging sign, a potted plant by the door. Editorial monochrome palette: near-black ink (#111111) facade and window frames, soft warm greys (#F4F4F2, #E6E6E6, #6B6B6B) for the building, sidewalk and evening sky, white highlights; the only warm color in the scene is the golden light from inside. + style
prompts.seo/hero: A single-family house under construction on a tidy lot, showing three stages at once: a freshly poured concrete foundation at the front corner, timber wall framing in the middle, and roof panels being set in place on top, a ladder leaning on the frame and a small stack of lumber on the ground. Modern clean palette: bright white background (#FFFFFF), very light grey ground (#FAFAFA), indigo (#4F46E5) on the roof panels, the ladder and the tools, a pale lavender (#EEF2FF) sky, near-black (#0A0A0A) fine details. + style
prompts.email-marketing/hero: A low close-up at grass level on a putting green: a crisp white golf ball resting on the very lip of the cup a moment before it drops in, the flagstick with a bright red flag (#D7263D) standing just behind the cup, the green in deep course green (#1E5E3A) with fine mown stripes, a soft cream (#FAF6EE) sky, bold simple shapes with a confident commercial feel. + style
prompts.facebook-ads/hero: A large billboard standing above a quiet suburban street at dusk; the billboard shows a beautifully lit, finished modern living room interior as a picture with no words; below it a row of tidy houses with warm porch lights on. Palette: soft grey (#F0F2F5) sky and street, white (#FFFFFF) houses and billboard frame, bright blue (#0866FF) accents on the billboard frame, the roofs and the street lamps, near-black (#050505) shadows, small touches of warm porch light. + style
prompts.ai-automation/hero: A cozy house porch in the evening: warm lights glowing in the windows and over the porch, the silhouette of a family relaxing inside behind the lit front window, a work pickup truck parked in the driveway with its tools put away, a quiet front yard with small path lights. Night palette: deep navy sky and ground (#0B1220), slate blue (#121B2E) siding, soft white (#F5F7FA) highlights, a mint green glow (#7CF5C8) on the path lights, the porch trim and the window light, a cool grey (#9AA4B2) evening mist. + style
prompts.seo/card: A single glossy 3D cartoon icon of {object}, centered and floating slightly above its own soft shadow on a plain flat pale lavender background (#EEF2FF).
